admission.justification: The parser alone accepts a setting without spending it; the transition alone spends a number without resolving the live user choice; approval, answer and instruction projections alone cannot prevent a competing ceiling. Together the five scoped contracts keep settings authority and cumulative accounting consistent across the operation.

guarantee: A task review uses the live positive settings budget plus recorded approved extras, and its supported state answers preserve that accounting without resetting count or sealed findings. The fallback/validation, begin-time read, approval attribution, legacy-answer projection and number-free instruction contract together keep a user setting authoritative rather than overruled by a separate ceiling or prose. Code and memory counts remain separate.
title: Settings-owned review budget and truthful accounting
